architecture.pattern: Material Design Multi-Tab Architecture with Clean Domain & Data Layers
layers: Presentation (Material BottomNavigationView Tabs: Library, Player, Studio, Settings)
architecture.a11y_strategy: WCAG 2.2 AAA & Android Accessibility Invariants (TalkBack & Jieshuo / CSR) with explicit contentDescription, polite live regions, and single-choice dialogs

requirements.title: Material Design Bottom Navigation
requirements.description: Restructure UI with 4 accessible bottom tabs: Library, Now Playing Player, Voice Studio, and Settings.
requirements.verification_criteria: BottomNavigationView switches content smoothly and announces tab names and selection state to TalkBack.

requirements.title: Voice Style Presets with Director Prompts
requirements.description: Inject proven director prompts for Documentary, Dramatic, Calm, and Natural styles into Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS requests.
requirements.verification_criteria: GeminiTtsClient prefixes text parts with director prompt tags that steer voice acting without verbalizing tags.

requirements.title: Multi-Speaker Dialogue Generation
requirements.description: Implement multiSpeakerVoiceConfig supporting 2 speakers (Narrator and Character) with automatic quote detection.
requirements.verification_criteria: Dialogue enclosed in quotation marks is assigned to secondary voice while narrative is assigned to primary voice.

requirements.title: Voice Design & Custom Voice ID Support
requirements.description: Allow creating custom voices from scratch via natural language description or entering an existing custom voice_id.
requirements.verification_criteria: Custom voice ID is passed directly to voiceConfig.voice in Gemini API requests.

requirements.title: Screen Reader Invariants
requirements.description: Ensure every UI element has accessible labels, no wide tables, and polite live status announcements.
requirements.verification_criteria: Zero unlabeled elements and smooth TalkBack / Jieshuo navigation.
